facts.fact: BCEAO says payment institutions are licensed in the Union under Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services, which binds Togo as a UMOA member; the document is dated by its list date, 28 February 2026.
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services in the UMOA

facts.fact: BCEAO list: three payment institutions licensed in Togo at 28 February 2026, of 31 in the Union (the page itself says 'trente (31)' and carries a January-dated PDF).
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services in the UMOA
